label: rem:topological-mass-dilogarithm-sketch
title: Argument sketch for the symmetric $q$-dilogarithm evaluation
html: Sketch. Integrating the q-deformed expansion flow over the resolved defect E_i in the spectral coordinates of the Briggs--Klein chart should give \int_0^{z_i} \ln_q(1+t)/t\, dt. The missing step is the evaluation of the non-abelian multiplicative integral in that chart. The second equality, \int_0^{z} \ln_q(1+t)/t\, dt = -\mathrm{Li}_2^q(-z), is termwise integration of the series for \ln_q (see the proof of the mass-endomorphism tower).
